## Install

```sh
claude plugin marketplace add idanfishman/skills
claude plugin install fishman@fishman
```

Turn on [`fishman-sdlc`](https://github.com/idanfishman/skills/tree/main/plugins/fishman-sdlc) per repository, as its README says. If you already have the marketplace, run `claude plugin marketplace update fishman` to get this version.

All changes are in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/idanfishman/skills/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
